decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-179 MODIFY that explicitly incorporates complete lessons, stories, and real points into its moment-selection criterion; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Adding real points as an acceptable complete-moment type does not change the independently specified Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok targets.
The expanded set of acceptable self-contained moment types does not alter the requirement that selected moments have effective hooks.
Message 179 independently changes clip duration to 45–60 seconds, but the source Event's addition of real points as acceptable moments does not itself change duration.
The source decision governs ongoing clip content and does not modify the completed task-local initial three-clip trial.
Accepting real points as complete moments does not change the clean editing style or effects policy.
The source content-type change does not affect caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The acceptable complete-moment types do not change who approves clips, which clips count toward quota, or the correction and publication rules.
The message-179 decision applies to ongoing production and does not revise the earlier task-local extended trial batch.
The addition of real points as acceptable ongoing clip moments does not alter the task-local requirement to produce one reference-matching requalification clip.
The source decision does not change the rule that client-approved clips are published to the assigned Instagram account.
Expanding acceptable clip moment types does not change tracking coverage, tracked metrics, or transparency requirements.
